newsitem.title: MEXICO: Gruma to make $120 mln share offer - Accival.
newsitem.headline: Gruma to make $120 mln share offer - Accival.

text.p: Mexican holding company Gruma, S.A. de C.V. will make a $120 million share offer from October 28, brokerage house Accival said.
The offer will be a mix of primary and secondary shares.

"The offer will be for a total of $120 million, of which $90 million corresponds to the secondary issue and $30 million in the primary," Accival director of corporate finance, Nadia Kadise told analysts.
The issue of series B shares is going to be made simulataneously in markets in Mexico, the United States and Europe, Kadise said.
The primary offer will be 3.2 million shares, while the secondary will be 16 million, Accival said.
The brokerage said Gruma estimates that 25 percent of the issue will be placed in Mexico and 75 percent outside of Mexico.
Outside of Mexico the shares will be offered in American Depositary Shares, each of which will be worth four series B shares.
The price will be fixed during the week of October 28, Kadise said.
Kadise added that Gruma will offer an option for 2.88 million shares if they are over-subscribed, which could lift the total to 22,080,000 shares.
In Mexico the operation will be led by Accival and Banorte, while outside of Mexico it will be lead by Morgan Stanley.
